questions.questionText: What is the primary language of the Vedas?
questions.questionTextEn: What is the primary language of the Vedas?
questions.explanation: The Vedas are written in Vedic Sanskrit.
questions.explanationEn: The Vedas are written in Vedic Sanskrit, an ancient Indo-Aryan language.

questions.explanation: Emperor Ashoka commissioned the Sanchi Stupa in the 3rd century BCE.
questions.explanationEn: Emperor Ashoka commissioned the construction of the Great Stupa at Sanchi.
